alerts.name: pulse_relay_behind
alerts.title: Relay is behind
alerts.description: The outbox relay is not keeping up: the oldest pending outbox row is over a minute old.

alerts.name: pulse_work_stuck
alerts.title: Work is stuck
alerts.description: Attempts are pending/retrying with nobody working them; the reconciliation sweep should have cleared them.

alerts.name: pulse_queue_backing_up
alerts.title: Queue backing up
alerts.description: A worker queue has over 1000 waiting jobs.

alerts.name: pulse_dead_letters_rising
alerts.title: Dead letters rising
alerts.description: More than 10 attempts were dead-lettered in 15 minutes.

alerts.name: pulse_provider_failing
alerts.title: Provider failing
alerts.description: Over 20% of a provider's calls are failing with provider errors.

alerts.name: pulse_provider_slow
alerts.title: Provider slow
alerts.description: A provider's p95 latency is over 5 seconds.

alerts.name: pulse_scheduler_silent
alerts.title: Scheduler silent
alerts.description: No state gauges are arriving, so the scheduler (outbox relay, sweeps) is probably down.
